title: Recording production
goal: Production recording on top of M5b's recording path: loop record with takes and playlists, MIDI recording, RF64, meeting the one-hour 16-track criterion.
prerequisites: M5b: m5b-engine-record, m5b-engine-monitoring and m5b-engine-punch-count-in are merged. Recording through the protocol, the monitoring modes, punch, pre-roll and count-in moved there on 2026-11-14 because the usable release (GitHub #83) needs them; this milestone keeps what production recording adds.
docs/harness/follow-ups.md, section Before M6b: items 3 to 6 (items 1 and 2 are taken by m5b-engine-record).

humanGates.text: Allow a one-hour 16-track recording run with a random kill on the maintainer's machine and device.
humanGates.how: The maintainer starts the run and leaves the machine idle; results are recorded.

features.title: RF64/BWF for takes above 4 GiB
acceptance: Takes switch to RF64 above 4 GiB; repair handles RF64; BWF timestamps carry the timeline position.

features.title: Loop record with one take per pass, mapped to playlists
acceptance: With cycle on, recording wraps at the right locator instead of running through it (m5b-engine-record's interim rule ends here); the loop range is the document's locators; one take per loop pass mapped to playlists; seamless loop playback with butler prefetch; punch, pre-roll and count-in of m5b-engine-punch-count-in keep working inside a loop.

features.title: MIDI input and MIDI takes
acceptance: midiInbox per device with timestamps converted to sample offsets; MIDI takes become MidiClips in MusicTime; overflow drops and sends all-notes-off.

exit.text: One hour of 16-track recording with a forced kill at a random time loses at most the last second of audio and no edits before the last journal fsync.
exit.how: Long run on the maintainer's machine (human gate).
